statement: Key a scripted fault to the call site under test, then prove the test with a mutant that reverts only that call site. Cejel #579's first test faked an empty GitHub run listing for the first two `gh run list` calls of any kind; an earlier stage's lookup absorbed both, so the test passed with the fix to stage 7's lookup reverted, and passed 66/66 for the wrong reason. Both review passes found it independently. Rules: scope a fake transient failure to the exact call it targets (here, publish-npm.yml listings; a run log read keyed by run id), and for each fixed call site run a mutant that reverts only that site and confirm the targeted test fails; a mutant reverting everything at once does not show which test pins which site.
